card.name: Dose splitting and per-unit slashes
card.fires_on: Words and symbols that sit where a split or rate is expressed in dosing text: 'divided' or 'between' after 'equally' or 'total', 'other' in 'every other day', and a slash in ratios or rates.

modes.label: Divided doses
modes.description: The word 'divided' or 'between' in phrases about splitting a total amount.
modes.example: the recommended daily dosage is 30 mg/kg/day in equally<< divided>> doses every 12 hours.

modes.label: Every other day
modes.description: The word 'other' in 'once every other day' in dosing tables.
modes.example: 0.3 mg once every<< other>> day Fosamprenavir (

modes.label: Slash in rates and ratios
modes.description: A slash after a unit or number that is followed by a time or a second number.
